subject: National Statistical Systems Training Academy (NSSTA), MoSPI - Documents and Offerings pages
collected_by: AI assistant (Claude Opus 5) under human direction
collection_method: Bounded manual-equivalent audit: targeted HTTP GET/HEAD requests to named public pages and candidate document URLs. No crawling, no link-following beyond the named pages, no bulk download.
authorisation_note: Explicitly authorised by the project owner on 2026-09-14 as Gate B desk research. This is a documented exception to standing rule R1 ('do not scrape') in DATA_COLLECTION_CHECKLIST.md.
personal_data_note: No participant names, officer names, attendance records, or any personal information were collected, stored, or transcribed. One discovered host (nssta.attendance.gov.in) serves personal attendance data and was deliberately excluded after recording its title only.

status_legend.MACHINE_OBSERVED: Directly observed by an automated request during this audit, with method and timestamp recorded. Pending human confirmation before it may become VERIFIED.
status_legend.UNVERIFIED_SECONDHAND: Reported by a third party (a search-engine summary), NOT observed first-hand at the source. A lead to check, not a fact.
status_legend.UNAVAILABLE: Investigated and confirmed not retrievable from this environment, with the reason recorded.
status_legend.EXCLUDED_BY_POLICY: Discovered but deliberately not collected, on privacy grounds.

verified_note: Zero items are VERIFIED. Per STATUS_VOCABULARY.md, only a human may set VERIFIED. Everything first-hand here is MACHINE_OBSERVED and awaits human sign-off.

headline_findings.finding: Both nssta.gov.in and mospi.gov.in are client-side-rendered single-page applications. They return an HTML shell of roughly 1-2.7 KB containing no content, navigation, or links to any non-JavaScript client.
headline_findings.consequence: Page-level HTML auditing and link discovery are impossible by plain HTTP fetch. Document discovery currently depends on direct file URLs found via external search indexes.

headline_findings.finding: No documented public API was found for NSSTA training data, programmes, or documents.
headline_findings.consequence: The SPA architecture implies an undocumented JSON backend exists. It was deliberately NOT probed, per API_REQUIREMENTS.md section 3: an undocumented endpoint is not a contract and using one is not authorised.

headline_findings.finding: Six NSSTA-related PDF documents were confirmed live with full HTTP metadata.
headline_findings.consequence: These are the only confirmed machine-retrievable artefacts for NSSTA at this time.

headline_findings.finding: PDF text could not be extracted in this environment. The training calendar uses embedded subset fonts with no recoverable ToUnicode mapping, and no PDF tooling (poppler, pypdf, PyMuPDF) is installed.
headline_findings.consequence: Training categories, programme names, and subject areas remain UNKNOWN first-hand. They were NOT guessed.

headline_findings.finding: nssta.attendance.gov.in is a live, server-rendered attendance portal for the academy.
headline_findings.consequence: Attendance data is personal data. Audit stopped at the page title. This host must be added to a permanent exclusion list.
